name: infra-nexus-ops
summary: Nexus 平台运维：仓库 CRUD + update、blobstore 管理、cleanup-policy 查询、inventory 导出/漂移检测；消费预热归 infra-artifact-readiness-ops。
runtime_requirements: Use infra-artifact-readiness-ops for build-time preload/readiness; use this skill for Nexus platform state.
post_install_hints: Use `nexusctl inventory summary` to overview repos.
Use `nexusctl inventory diff --against <ledger>` to detect drift.
Use `nexusctl blobstore list` to check blob stores.

integrations.contract: 发布/废弃/同步、bump 版本、lock 刷新
